_doc: Feature soak campaign (card featuresoak, docs/probes/feature-soak-2026-11-26.md). Every row is a LAB row: lockstep d2d, headless, fresh prep hero (declared SETUP before the start, none after), the bot plays `hours` virtual hours under the arm's knobs. CHEATED/lab: mechanics and relative A/B only, never live parity. An arm is a knob set (tuning overrides, json); the baseline arm is the shipped defaults. A feature compares its `on` arm with its `off` arm (for a feature that ships ON the off arm switches it off; for a dark feature the on arm switches it on). Run with: python3 tools/provingground/featuresoak.py run tools/provingground/campaigns/features-2026-11-26.json An arm key `_bot` selects a bot binary variant (bin/d2bot.<name>, built from a tree with one commit taken back; see `bots`); every other key is a tuning override. `bot.admission` of the brief does not exist: admission is data (internal/plandata/admission.json) plus route.earlyRoute, so the kit floor and poverty farm arm is a build variant.

bots.base: origin/main build (the tree this campaign ran from)
bots.nokit: origin/main with the kit floor tiers data and the poverty farm of commit d784bc19d taken out (admission.json tiers removed, admit.go and povertyfarm.go from its parent)
bots.nosac: origin/main with the aura2b Paladin Sacrifice change (commits 2c16ed211 and 976e94993: profiles, rules, agency derive) reverse-applied
bots.nonecro: origin/main with the necro1 default summoner table change (commit 79473a84d: build json) taken back to its parent
